nodes.label: Knowledge Access Process

nodes.label: Knowledge Synthesis Process
nodes.rationale: One of three core knowledge processes: automatic generation of business reports, sales proposals, marketing materials, project proposals.

nodes.label: GAIK Layer-Based Architecture
nodes.rationale: Spans from strategic planning to implementation and security: Strategy, Requirements, Business, Implementation, Security Compliance, and Guidance layers.

nodes.label: Build Software Component Skill
nodes.rationale: Creates a new GAIK software component as an installable Python package; follows a 6-phase workflow: Context Gathering, Plan Creation, Plan Review, Execution, Verification, and optional Full Release.

nodes.label: GAIK Component Conventions Reference
nodes.rationale: Defines directory layout, __init__.py patterns, constructor patterns, result dataclass patterns, and extras naming for all new GAIK software components.

nodes.label: GAIK Component File Templates Reference
nodes.rationale: Provides literal file templates (8 templates) for __init__.py, main class, README, example, pyproject.toml edit, and parent __init__.py edits.

nodes.label: GAIK Component Verification Reference
nodes.rationale: Defines install command, import smoke test, example run, and final status report steps plus common failure modes for new components.

nodes.label: GAIK Add Examples Skill
nodes.rationale: Adds or updates working code examples for GAIK toolkit components and pipelines; offers gated follow-ups: API docs, Fumadocs website, demo app, PyPI release tag.

nodes.label: Business Layer README
nodes.rationale: Business layer supports GenAI solution design: use case definition (GenAI product canvas), workflow analysis (extended BPMN), and work system analysis and redesign.

nodes.label: GenAI Product Canvas

nodes.label: VisionExtractor
nodes.rationale: Single-pass PDF/image to structured data via vision LLM; supports OpenAI, Claude, Google; include_verification wraps fields in VerifiableField with confidence_score and reasoning.

nodes.label: ParallelTranscriber
nodes.rationale: Production-grade parallel transcription using FFmpeg chunking; requires ffmpeg+ffprobe on PATH; supports TranscriptionModel.WHISPER and GPT4O_DIARIZE.

nodes.label: LLMJudge
nodes.rationale: Validates extracted data using rubric scoring (Likert 1-5), hallucination detection, and text-pair equivalence; supports multiple providers.

nodes.label: PgVectorStore

nodes.label: Knowledge Extraction Process
nodes.rationale: One of three core GAIK knowledge processes: extracting structured information from unstructured content such as documents, PDFs, and audio transcripts.

nodes.label: Knowledge Capture Process
nodes.rationale: One of three core GAIK knowledge processes: precise and accurate retrieval of information from various data sources through techniques like RAG.

nodes.label: Knowledge Generation Process
nodes.rationale: One of three core GAIK knowledge processes: using structured representations and AI models to produce summaries, reports, insights, and tailored outputs.

nodes.label: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
nodes.rationale: Core technique in the Knowledge Capture process; supported by a set of RAG software components: parser, embedder, vector store, retriever, answer generator.

nodes.label: SchemaGenerator Class
nodes.rationale: Generates Pydantic extraction schemas from natural language requirements. Part of the extractor software component.

nodes.label: DataExtractor Class
nodes.rationale: Extracts structured data from documents using a Pydantic schema and natural language requirements.

nodes.label: VisionExtractor Class
nodes.rationale: Single-pass PDF/image to structured data via vision LLM. Combines visual document understanding and structured extraction in one API call. Supports OpenAI/Azure, Anthropic, and Google.

nodes.label: DocumentClassifier Class
nodes.rationale: Classifies PDFs, Word documents, and images into predefined categories using LLM analysis with confidence scoring.

nodes.label: Transcriber Class
nodes.rationale: Transcribes audio and video using OpenAI Whisper with optional GPT enhancement. Handles chunking for files >25MB.

nodes.label: LLMJudge Class
nodes.rationale: Multi-provider LLM-as-judge validator. Supports validate(), judge_text_pair(), and detect_hallucinations() methods. Providers: OpenAI, Azure, Anthropic, Google Vertex.

nodes.label: VisionParser
nodes.rationale: High-quality PDF/image parsing with table extraction via LLM vision. Slower but highest quality, requires API.

nodes.label: PyMuPDFParser
nodes.rationale: Fast local PDF text extraction. No API required.

nodes.label: DocxParser
nodes.rationale: Fast local Word document (.docx/.doc) parsing.

nodes.label: DoclingParser
nodes.rationale: Advanced OCR with multi-format support and optional GPU acceleration.

nodes.label: Embedder Class
nodes.rationale: Generates vector embeddings from text using OpenAI/Azure embedding models (default: text-embedding-3-large). Supports batch processing.

nodes.label: VectorStore Class
nodes.rationale: Stores embeddings and metadata. Default: in-memory; optional Chroma persistence. Used in RAG retrieval pipeline.

nodes.label: Retriever Class
nodes.rationale: Semantic and optional hybrid (BM25) retriever for RAG workflows. Supports reranking with cross-encoder.

nodes.label: AnswerGenerator Class
nodes.rationale: Generates answers from retrieved context using OpenAI/Azure. Supports citations, streaming, and conversation history.

nodes.label: DoclingRagParser Class
nodes.rationale: Docling-based PDF parser producing LangChain Document chunks. Uses HierarchicalChunker for structure-based chunking. Requires FFmpeg.

nodes.label: VisionRagParser Class
nodes.rationale: Combines Docling structure analysis with AI vision models for image interpretation; produces LangChain Document chunks.

nodes.label: Software Components Documentation

nodes.label: Transcriber Component
nodes.rationale: OpenAI Whisper-based speech-to-text with optional GPT enhancement. Automatic chunking for long recordings.

nodes.label: Document Parser Component
nodes.rationale: Converts PDF/DOCX to clean markdown. Vision-based (GPT) and local (PyMuPDF, Docling) strategies. Preserves tables, headings, structure.

nodes.label: Extractor Component
nodes.rationale: Natural language requirements -> Requirement Parser -> Schema Generator -> Data Extractor. Type-safe Pydantic validation. Schema persistence.

nodes.label: Vision Extractor Component
nodes.rationale: PDFs/images directly to structured data in single LLM call. Multi-document support, multi-provider (OpenAI/Azure, Anthropic, Google), optional per-field confidence scores.

nodes.label: Document Classifier Component
nodes.rationale: LLM-based zero-shot classification with user-defined classes in plain language. Returns predicted class and confidence score.

nodes.label: LLM-as-Judge Validator
nodes.rationale: Second-pass LLM over extractor output. Returns per-field ok/suspect/wrong flags with reasons and suggested values. Recommended model: gemini-3-flash-preview (F1=1.000 at $0.004/PO).

nodes.label: RAG Components Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Five composable blocks: RAG Parser, Embedder, Vector Store (Chroma or PgVector), Retriever (optional reranking), Answer Generator (citations). Two backends: ChromaDB and PostgreSQL+pgvector.

nodes.label: Software Modules Documentation
nodes.rationale: Production-ready end-to-end pipelines: AudioToStructuredData, DocumentToStructuredData, RAGWorkflow.

nodes.label: Audio-to-Structured-Data Module
nodes.rationale: Combines Transcriber and Extractor. Returns raw transcript, enhanced transcript, structured fields, reusable schema.

nodes.label: Document-to-Structured-Data Module
nodes.rationale: Combines Document Parser and Extractor. Returns parsed markdown, structured fields, reusable schema.

nodes.label: RAG-Workflow Module
nodes.rationale: Combines all 5 RAG components: two phases (indexing and query). Persistent vector store, conversation history, streaming, citations.

nodes.label: Extraction Evaluation
